result: Kernel-checked, with 0 sorry and only the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound: (1) BornGaussianParallelogramRigidity: zero-weight residuals on Q(i)^3 that vanish on the nine tomography rays and satisfy the orthogonal parallelogram law vanish identically, so such frame functions equal quadRay (tomographyForm f); (2) GleasonRealSphere: Gleason's theorem for continuous frame functions on the real sphere in three dimensions; (3) GleasonComplexSphere: Gleason's theorem for continuous frame functions on the complex sphere in three dimensions, derived from (2) on fully real subspaces; (4) GleasonGaussianBridge: born_of_uniformlyRayContinuous, every frame function on Q(i)^3 that is uniformly continuous on rays (declared input IsUniformlyRayContinuous) equals quadRay (tomographyForm f) on all nonzero vectors.
proof_boundary: The result is conditional on the declared input IsUniformlyRayContinuous f (uniform continuity on rays in the squared ray distance raySinSq), a mathematical input that requires justification and is not derived here; recorded as DAG node FQ-GLEASON-QI3-UNIFORM-RAY-CONTINUITY (CONDITIONAL). Whether pointwise Archimedean continuity at every nonzero vector implies it for frame functions is the named open sub-question FQ-GLEASON-QI3-POINTWISE-TO-UNIFORM (OPEN); signed and nonnegative versions are distinguished there. The pointwise-continuity targets of FQ-GLEASON-QI3-FRAME-FUNCTIONS (OPEN) and FQ-GAP-BORN-UNIQUENESS-GLEASON (CONDITIONAL) keep their statements and statuses; neither the conditional theorem nor the unsuccessful attempts settle them. No Lean declaration instantiates IsUniformlyRayContinuous (non-vacuity is argued on paper only in dag/research/pointwise_vs_uniform_note.md).
